== Biography ==
Adam was born about 1829. He was the youngest son of [[Glasgow-2603|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Lamb-11245|Mary Lamb]]. 

He married Mary Stewart in 1866.

He passed away in 1880.
== Research Notes ==
